name: hud_ui_fill_bitmap_update_normalized_from_cursor
description: HudUiFillBitmap::UpdateNormalizedFromCursor derives a normalized value from the owner cursor X coordinate and widget center, applies it through the fill-bitmap table, and activates the ZRD widget base.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the coherent HudUiFillBitmap source/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4b8650 subtracts the widget center X from owner->cursorX, divides by base image width, dispatches the fill-bitmap SetNormalizedValue slot, then calls HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.

Native smoke zhud_fill_bitmap_update_normalized_call_contract_smoke configures owner cursor X, base image width, and fill image state, verifies UpdateNormalizedFromCursor stores 0.25f and rebuilds the fill rectangle, and uses a derived activation probe to prove that the helper calls the HudUiZrdWidget base implementation directly instead of redispatching virtually.
